waveform_model.limitations: Ideal grounded voltage sources with per-component periodic sine or linear pulse ramps. No output resistance, current limit, battery discharge, noise or physical generator identity. Finite pulse high/low phase lengths include rise/fall respectively. Output sampling can alias; internal integration resolves waveform features within its work budget.

diode_model.limitations: Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity.

pnp_model.limitations: Educational complementary PNP Ebers–Moll model; same illustrative parameter magnitudes as the generic NPN, not a named or physically matched device. No breakdown, Early effect, heating, junction capacitance, charge storage or switching delay. External capacitors provide circuit timing.

opamp_model.limitations: Generic five-pin educational macromodel with differential input resistance, midpoint-centered soft voltage limiting, finite output resistance, bounded active output current, supply-dependent enable and explicit supply currents. A declared 1 Gohm output-to-V- bleed remains with power off or reversed; differential input resistance also remains. No internal bandwidth, slew rate, offset/bias mismatch, common-mode restrictions, protection diodes, noise, thermal behavior, ratings or named physical device. External storage supplies circuit timing; this model cannot qualify physical amplifier speed or stability.

led_model.limitations: Educational generic diode; no physical part identity, reverse breakdown, thermal dynamics, ratings, or calibrated brightness.

npn_model.limitations: Educational Ebers–Moll model; no named physical device, breakdown, Early effect, heating, junction capacitance, charge storage or switching delay. External capacitors provide circuit timing. LED reverse current is neglected.
